The Blade Battalion tokens are included in the Baron Blade Senario, which is part of the core set.

Unity and her bots are included in Uprising. Anyone who gets Uprising gets all of the Stretch Goal Characters. And jsut to be clear, Heroic Combat pledge level does include all of Uprising.

Heroic Figures level only gives minis for the characters found in the core game, and does not include minis from any characters in Uprising. Super Heroic Figures includes the minis from Uprising in addition to those of the core set.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Cosmonautilus comes to Earth, defeats all the heroes and armies and villains and everyone.

Only to be defeated by the one power Cosmonautilus could not predict or counter.

Thiago and his partner Tumbleweed, aided by the lingering spirit of the Hippo, who was saved from death by Unity who turned him into the most powerful of her Golems:  HippoBotamus Prime!

The new world forged in the aftermath would experience an event unparralleled in human history, when HippoBotamus Prime merged with the power of Cosmonautilus and brought about a cosmic event known as:

The Hippocalypse.

All the villains and Heroes would fight for ages to control this new source of power, until far in the future it would eventually cause the destruction of mankind, and the rise of all sorts of creatures.  Only Haka would survive the chaos, and used the Library to research what had actually happened.

After millenia alone with the books he discovered that the Cosmonautilus was in fact some creature known as Guise, and that all of the creatures outside the Library were also Guise, and that the books were Guise, and that Con was HippoGuise.

When he realized this he heard a rustling wind, and turning saw a young boy.

"We are Guise." it said.

"Thiago?" Haka replied.

"We are Guise." it said again, and then a strange wind blew through the Library, hot and dry.

"We are also Guise."  Haka heard whispered on the wind, and when he looked, he could see them.  They were coming, through time and space, from all corners of reality.

"Tumbleweed?"  Haka couldn't believe what his eyes told him.

"We are Guise. . ."
